literal_meaning: মুখে জল দেওয়া (giving water to the mouth)
figurative_meaning_en: To quench someone's thirst or provide basic care in times of need
similar_in_english: Lend a helping hand in need
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমার বাছার মুখে জল দেওয়ার কেউ নেই।
পথিকের মুখে জল দিয়ে তাকে সাহায্য করলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: There is no one to give water to my child's mouth.
He helped the traveler by giving water to quench his thirst.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali hospitality and familial care, often used in contexts of vulnerability.
